column1: # Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate: Objective contract manifest. Written by `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --pin`;
# an added, removed, restated, redefined or re-axiomed row needs a line in scripts/gates/objective-contract-decisions.txt.

column8: ∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes} {write : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite}, write ∈ intent.writes → ∀ (domain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (role : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityCell.Role) (key : List UInt8), write.cellId = { value := Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityCell.coordinate domain role key } → ∃ cell, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.ordinaryGate intent = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.RejectReason.protectedWrite cell)

∀ (writes : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.firstProtected writes = Option.none ↔ ∀ write ∈ writes, ¬Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.Protected write.cellId

∀ {writes : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite} {cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.firstProtected writes = Option.some cell → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.Protected cell ∧ ∃ write ∈ writes, write.cellId = cell

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.ordinaryGate intent = Except.ok () ↔ ∀ write ∈ intent.writes, ¬Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.Protected write.cellId

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes} {write : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite}, write ∈ intent.writes → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.Protected write.cellId → ∃ cell, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.ordinaryGate intent = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.RejectReason.protectedWrite cell) ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.Protected cell ∧ ∃ named ∈ intent.writes, named.cellId = cell

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (schedule : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Schedule) (before : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes) {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.ordinaryGate intent = Except.ok () → ∀ {cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.Protected cell → (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.Outcome.storeAfter before (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.execute schedule before intent)).canonicalBytes cell = before.canonicalBytes cell

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (before : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes) {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.ordinaryGate intent = Except.ok () → ∀ {cell : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.Protected cell → (before.install intent).canonicalBytes cell = before.canonicalBytes cell

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.ordinaryGate intent = Except.ok () → ∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {write : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite}, write ∈ intent.writes → Minidregg.Kernel.ResourceBirthController.Concrete.PhysicalPostLaw deployment write → ∃ cell, (Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.codec Minidregg.Kernel.ResourceBirthController.Concrete.Registry).decode write.canonicalPostBytes = Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.live cell) ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.CellLaw deployment write.cellId.value cell
